notes.title: Albert and Otto: Update (TRADING CARDS)
notes.content:
[h1]TRADING CARDS and Update v1.4[/h1]

Excited to announce that the trading cards have been approved and are finally here! 

[img]http://www.albertandotto.com/steamimages/TradingCards_SteamImage.png[/img]

There are also cool sets of badges and emoticons to unlock along with the Trading card drops.

[img]http://www.albertandotto.com/steamimages/BadgesSteam.png[/img]

And of course I just couldn't resist putting a few more little details into the game itself. 

[h1]Additions: [/h1]
[list]
    [*]A more robust xinput controller support implemented
    [*]Added extra art assets to the end scene
    [*]Added an "Are you sure?" screen to new game option, ensuring that save files do not get wiped by accident.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fixed visual glitch that caused a box to flash at the stream area
    [*]Fixed death counter bug that caused it to sometimes give the wrong death count.
[/list]

As always thank you for your support and I hope you have a great weekend.

Feel free to follow me on twitter [url=twitter.com/nikmakesgames] @nikmakesgames[/url]

Nik

notes.title: Albert and Otto: Update
notes.content:
STORY UPDATE  v1.3

I am very excited about this update, I've been looking forward to adding this extra content to the game for a while and it's finally here.

[img]http://www.albertandotto.com/steamimages/letterbox.png[/img]

[h1]Postboxes [/h1]

In addition to collecting the shard pieces and unlocking the clue to Albert's past the player will now encounter mailboxes scattered throughout the game, in them he will find letters from his sister, each one has a drawing that reveals a little more about his sister and the events that transpired.

[img]http://www.albertandotto.com/steamimages/letter.png[/img]

If you have already completed this episode and are interested in learning more about the story, it would be worth your while to jump back in for seconds. :)

[img]http://www.albertandotto.com/steamimages/artassets.png[/img]

I have also included a few more background assets that will hopefully offer up further clues.

[h1]Next Update [/h1]

Next week there will be more exciting stuff, I will be adding Steam achievements and support for a wider range of controllers.

As always thank you for your support.
Nik

notes.title: Albert and Otto: Update
notes.content:
[h1]UPDATE v1.2[/h1]

Another week another update. This time I have added a couple of features and a bit of story content. All your constructive reviews/comments are key to making A&O a better game so thank you for all your input.

[h1]Features[/h1]

[olist]
    [*]Added a shattered picture frame which the player must fill in by collecting shards scattered throughout the game. Collecting all 25 of them will reveal a big clue to Albert's past. 

[img]http://www.albertandotto.com/steamimages/Frame_SteamUpdate.png[/img]

    [*]Added in-game menu which includes options for the following:
[list]
    [*]music volume slider
    [*]sfx volume slider
    [*]Vsync toggle on/off
    [*]Resolution Settings
    [*]Quality settings
    [*]Levitation sensitivity slider (for controller)
[/list]

 [*]Added mouse support in menus

 [*]Added a death counter at the end of the game that will show player how many times he has died and how. Share your screenshot on twitter and tag @albertandotto I really look forward to seeing your stats :) 

[img]http://www.albertandotto.com/steamimages/Deaths_SteamPage.png[/img]

[/olist]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

- Fixed rare animation glitch that caused final boss to turn head wrong way
- Fixed rare glitch that made Albert slide on the floating tree log. 
- Fixed minor bugs and glitches

As always, thank you for supporting Albert & Otto

notes.title: Albert and Otto: Update
notes.content:
[h1]UPDATE v1.1[/h1]

Celebrating the second week of the first episode of Albert & Otto on Steam. 

This update contains some fixes including the much requested additional checkpoint at the rafting sequence.


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/368590/extras/gameMechanics_AlbertandOtto_Steam.png?t=1446913713[/img]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
   [*] Added extra checkpoint to first rafting area
   [*] Improved overall performance on slower machines
   [*] Improved collision detection on boss battle.
   [*] Fixed a rare bug that caused end scene not triggering properly
   [*] Fixed a rare bug that caused the teeter totter to not reset properly
   [*] Fixed the bug that caused the magnet pulley to not reset properly.
   [*] Fixed small bugs and glitches throughout game.
[/list]


*No sheep have been harmed in the making of the new teaser:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rz9kXvoKBxI

[b] THANK YOU FOR SUPPORTING ALBERT & OTTO :)[/b]

notes.title: Small Update: Performance Fix
notes.content:
Hey Guys. 

A couple of you were experiencing issues with non-smooth game-play and hard to make jumps. Most of this can be attributed to the game being set to ULTRA graphic quality as its default setting in the launcher causing slightly older computers to lag. 

If you are experiencing such issues and your computer meets the minimum requirements please turn the settings down a notch or two in the game launcher and your experience should improve tenfold. (the latest update now selects the medium option by default)

Big thank you to the people who have reported bugs and suggestions for improvements, I am hard at work on an Update and will have a little extra content for you guys in a few weeks as well :) 

Nik
